reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur, ph.list_price_eur
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND cp.competitor = 'Bliksem'
  AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  AND cp.price_eur < ph.list_price_eur

solver.query:
SELECT p.product_name, cp.observed_ts, cp.price_eur, h.list_price_eur
FROM competitor_prices cp
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = cp.product_id
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = cp.product_id AND h.valid_to IS NULL
WHERE cp.competitor = 'Bliksem'
  AND cp.observed_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND cp.observed_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
  AND cp.price_eur < h.list_price_eur
